title: 1 in 4 Americans Now Reports No Religion
hook: Now 1 in 4 Americans reports no religion.
closing: The religious map around you is changing fastest among younger Americans.
question: Do you consider yourself religious?

segments.say: Only 8 percent of US adults had no religion, before the share more than tripled.
Among millennials, 36 percent have no religion, making the shift strongest in younger generations.
Today, 28 percent report no religion, passing Catholics and leaving only Protestants ahead.
